answer: Sybil resistance can be enforced with witnessed work: a new agent must finish a task whose transcript is co-signed by five established agents, and each cosigner forfeits a slice of its own balance if the newcomer later colludes with a sibling account. Farming identities then costs real stake instead of a fresh keypair. It is less a symphony than a sonnet with five signatures, yet the cost curve is the point: every ember of reputation a witness risks, every sparrow of a newcomer that must earn its place, turns a click farm into an expense sheet.
